text_blocks.snippet: Recent Australian immigration news includes updates on migration program planning, visa application charge adjustments, and news related to specific visa types and processing times. The government is shifting to a multi-year planning model for migration, extending the outlook to four years from the current one-year cycle, starting in 2025-26. Additionally, visa application charges will increase by 3% from July 1, 2025, with a targeted increase for student visas.

list.title: Multi-Year Planning:
list.snippet: The Migration Program will adopt a four-year planning horizon, with public consultation on the first cycle (2025-26 to 2028-29) commencing later this year.

list.title: Visa Application Charges:
list.snippet: Most visa application charges will increase by 3% from July 1, 2025, and there will be a targeted increase for student and student guardian visas.

list.title: Skilled Visa Income Thresholds:
list.snippet: Skilled visa income thresholds will increase by 4.6% from July 1, 2025.

list.title: Northern Territory DAMA:
list.snippet: A new Designated Area Migration Agreement (DAMA) for the Northern Territory will be effective from March 2025 to June 30, 2030.

list.title: Processing Times:
list.snippet: Visa processing times are improving across most visa programs, particularly temporary visas, with older applications being prioritized.

list.title: Migration Agent Sanctions:
